findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The baffles of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of black mold buildup. PIC was made aware. PIC unplugged the ice machine and dumped the ice. The ice machine baffles were cleaned while inspector was present.  Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the baffles of the ice machine are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized on a regular basis.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking sealing the counter top on the wall left of the dish machine was observed coming off. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the caulking will be done. Ensure that the caulking is fixed providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a build up of soil in the soda nozzles of the Coca Cola soda machine. PIC was made aware of the soiled nozzles and the nozzles were removed, replaced, and cleaned. Ensure that food-contact surfaces such as the nozzles of the soda machine are monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The refrigeration in the walk-in cooler was observed with a loose screw causing the condenser water output unit to leak water in the walk-in. The unit appeared functional and the temperatures are stable. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that the relevant repairs will be done. PIC has a plastic container under the refrigeration unit to catch the water for the time being until the appropriate repairs are done.  Ensure that the appropriate repairs are done accordingly to prevent any malfunctions.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed soup bowls being handled by the inside rim of the bowl immediately after soup was put into the bowl. Discussed with PIC. PIC agreed to only handle bowls by the bottom face. Ensure bowls are handled properly to prevent food contamination. Inspector will return 02/24/2025 to re-asses violation.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed the dish machine to be testing at 0 PPM CL. Discussed with PIC. PIC ran regular bleach through the machine to test if the issue was the sanitizer bucket or with the dispensing mechanics. PIC deduced that the problem was with the sanitizing solution, and not with the machine itself. PIC stated that they will order a new bucket of sanitizer for the machine. Until new sanitizer is used, use triple sink to wash, rinse, and sanitize the dishes. Inspector will return 02/24/2025 to re-asses violations.
findings.citation_text: 4-703.11(C)(1) Hot Water and Chemical. After being cleaned, equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be sanitized in: (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations, including the application of SANITIZING chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods, using a solution as specified under § 4-501.114. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA registered label use instructions by providing: (1) Except as specified under Subparagraph (C)(2) of this section, a contact time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution specified under 4-501.114(A).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed there to be a build up of mold on the caulk beside and behind the dish sprayer arm. Along with this, the dish table was not caulked to the wall. Discussed repairs with PIC. PIC agreed to replace moldy caulk and add caulk to areas along the dish table
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: There was observed raw chicken stored over raw pork in the walk in cooler. PIC was made aware of this and the chicken was moved to the bottom shelf and the pork was moved to the shelf above it. Ensure that food is properly stored following the storage order posted to the external of the walk-in cooler. 
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The sanitizer bucket near the boxing station was tested and recorded at 0ppm chlorine. PIC was made aware and added bleach to this bucket. The solution was retested and recorded at 200ppm chlorine. Ensure that sanitizer buckets are tested at frequency necessary to ensure their efficacy remains and that they are changed at a frequency necessary to maintain the correct concentrations. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The top of the dish machine is observed to have an accumulation of debris and soils. PIC was made aware and will include this item in their nightly cleaning. Ensure the surfaces of equipment are cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
